pr_title: Add the possibility to always show detection circles
pr_body:
Closes #19830.

Testcase: Add `Visible: Always` to the `RenderDetectionCircle` traits of minelayers or subs in RA.

issue_context.title: RenderDetectionCircle doesnt appear on a call-in Aircraft actor
issue_context.body:
Its because seems to be hardcoded to render only on selection. And Aircraft called in from outside the map generally rejects orders and are interactable instead of being selectable.
As a workaround, an WithRangeCircle:  can be setup to imitate it closely, yet there will be appearance differences.

review_comments: Just throwing it in here: We should get around to enabling spatial partitioning on any kind of circles at some point, right now we're rendering any visible circles all the time, regardless of how far they are from the viewport.
